slides.note: Gate 1 (week 3): use case 1 has usable data, a risk class and a named model owner; otherwise we swap to the next use case. Technical unknowns we price in: which of the three use cases has production-ready data; access to personal data for training (minimised, pseudonymised); EU AI Act classification per use case.
